coverage: The prologues and all 24 scenes: main cast, differentiated servants, guest-list people and relatives, musicians, watchmen and named allusions.

entities.name: Romeo
entities.body: Lord and Lady Montague’s son, one of the play’s two central lovers.

snapshots.body: The young Montague, now Juliet’s husband.

entities.name: Juliet
entities.body: Lord and Lady Capulet’s daughter, the play’s other central lover.

snapshots.body: The young Capulet, now Romeo’s wife.

entities.name: The Nurse
entities.body: Juliet’s nurse and longtime companion, also called Angelica.

entities.name: Friar Lawrence
entities.body: The Franciscan friar to whom Romeo turns for advice.

entities.name: Mercutio
entities.body: Romeo’s friend and a relative of Prince Escalus.

entities.name: Benvolio
entities.body: Romeo’s cousin and friend, a member of the Montague family.

entities.name: Tybalt
entities.body: Juliet’s cousin, Lady Capulet’s nephew.

entities.name: Lord Capulet
entities.body: Juliet’s father and head of the Capulet household.

entities.name: Lady Capulet
entities.body: Juliet’s mother and Lord Capulet’s wife.

entities.name: Lord Montague
entities.body: Romeo’s father and head of the Montague household.

entities.name: Lady Montague
entities.body: Romeo’s mother and Lord Montague’s wife.

entities.name: Paris
entities.body: The young nobleman seeking to marry Juliet, a relative of the prince.

entities.name: Prince Escalus
entities.body: The ruler of Verona.

entities.name: Rosaline
entities.body: Capulet’s niece, the young woman Romeo admires at the start of the play.

entities.name: Sampson
entities.body: A servant of the Capulet household, companion of Gregory.

entities.name: Gregory
entities.body: A servant of the Capulet household, companion of Sampson.

entities.name: Abram
entities.body: A servant of the Montague household.

entities.name: Balthasar
entities.body: Romeo’s servant.

entities.name: Peter
entities.body: The Capulet servant who accompanies the Nurse.

entities.name: Friar John
entities.body: A Franciscan friar associated with Friar Lawrence.

entities.name: The apothecary
entities.body: The impoverished seller of medicines in Mantua.

entities.name: Paris’s page
entities.body: The young attendant accompanying Paris.

entities.name: Capulet’s cousin
entities.body: The older kinsman talking with Capulet at the feast.

entities.name: The Chorus
entities.body: The speaker who introduces the play and its second act.

entities.name: The Capulets
entities.body: Juliet’s family and household, rivals of the Montagues.

entities.name: The Montagues
entities.body: Romeo’s family and household, rivals of the Capulets.

entities.name: The musicians
entities.body: The musicians engaged for the Capulet household’s festivities.

entities.name: The citizens of Verona
entities.body: The townspeople drawn into the public disturbances.

entities.name: The watch
entities.body: The officers responsible for keeping order in Verona.

entities.name: The gods
entities.body: The divine powers invoked in the saying about lovers’ promises.

entities.name: The invitation-bearing servant
entities.body: The Capulet servant sent to find the guests named on a list.

entities.name: The dinner-announcing servant
entities.body: The servant who tells Lady Capulet that supper is ready.

entities.name: The first feast servant
entities.body: The servant organizing the clearing and service at Capulet’s feast.

entities.name: The second feast servant
entities.body: The servant answering his colleague during preparations at Capulet’s feast.

entities.name: The servant by Romeo
entities.body: The servant whom Romeo asks about Juliet at the feast.

entities.name: The wedding invitation servant
entities.body: The servant sent out with Capulet’s wedding invitations.

entities.name: The servant hiring cooks
entities.body: The servant whom Capulet sends to hire cooks.

entities.name: The servant carrying supplies
entities.body: The servant carrying provisions for the wedding cook.

entities.name: The servant finding logs
entities.body: The servant sent for firewood during the wedding preparations.

entities.name: The first citizen
entities.body: The Verona citizen speaking when the street fights draw the townspeople.

entities.name: The first watchman
entities.body: The watchman directing the search in the churchyard.

entities.name: The second watchman
entities.body: One of the officers searching the churchyard.

entities.name: The third watchman
entities.body: Another officer searching the churchyard.

entities.name: Simon Catling
entities.body: The first musician, whom Peter addresses as Simon Catling.

entities.name: Hugh Rebeck
entities.body: The second musician, whom Peter addresses as Hugh Rebeck.

entities.name: James Soundpost
entities.body: The third musician and singer, whom Peter addresses as James Soundpost.

entities.name: Susan
entities.body: The Nurse’s daughter, who was the same age as Juliet.

entities.name: The Nurse’s husband
entities.body: The Nurse’s late husband, recalled in her story about Juliet’s childhood.

entities.name: Susan Grindstone
entities.body: The woman whom a servant wants admitted to Capulet’s feast.

entities.name: Nell
entities.body: The woman named with Susan Grindstone at the feast.

entities.name: Antony
entities.body: One of the Capulet household servants called during the feast.

entities.name: Potpan
entities.body: The Capulet servant called for during preparations at the feast.

entities.name: Lucentio
entities.body: The man whose wedding Capulet recalls while talking with his older kinsman.

entities.name: Lucentio’s son
entities.body: The son whose age Capulet’s cousin uses to date Lucentio’s wedding.

entities.name: Tiberio
entities.body: The father of one of the young men at Capulet’s feast.

entities.name: Tiberio’s son
entities.body: The young guest identified by the Nurse as Tiberio’s son and heir.

entities.name: Petruchio
entities.body: The young man whom the Nurse identifies among the departing guests.

entities.name: Signior Martino
entities.body: One of the people named on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Martino’s wife
entities.body: The wife invited with Signior Martino and their daughters.

entities.name: Martino’s daughters
entities.body: The daughters invited with Signior Martino and his wife.

entities.name: Count Anselmo
entities.body: The count named on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Anselmo’s sisters
entities.body: The sisters included with Count Anselmo on the guest list.

entities.name: Utruvio
entities.body: The deceased husband of a woman on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Utruvio’s widow
entities.body: The widowed woman invited to Capulet’s feast.

entities.name: Signior Placentio
entities.body: One of the men on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Placentio’s nieces
entities.body: The nieces invited with Signior Placentio.

entities.name: Valentine
entities.body: Mercutio’s brother, included on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Capulet’s uncle
entities.body: The uncle listed among Capulet’s invited guests.

entities.name: The uncle’s wife
entities.body: The wife invited with Capulet’s uncle and their daughters.

entities.name: The uncle’s daughters
entities.body: The daughters invited with Capulet’s uncle and his wife.

entities.name: Livia
entities.body: The woman named alongside Rosaline on the guest list.

entities.name: Signior Valentio
entities.body: Tybalt’s cousin, named on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Lucio
entities.body: The guest named alongside Helena.

entities.name: Helena
entities.body: The woman named alongside Lucio on Capulet’s guest list.

entities.name: Friar John’s companion
entities.body: The fellow friar whom John seeks out to accompany him.

entities.name: The health officials
entities.body: The town officials responsible for restrictions around plague-infected houses.

entities.name: Aurora
entities.body: The Roman goddess of dawn.

entities.name: Cupid
entities.body: The winged god of love, son of Venus.

entities.name: Diana
entities.body: The goddess associated with chastity and the moon, also called Cynthia.

entities.name: Queen Mab
entities.body: The tiny fairy queen in Mercutio’s speech about dreams.

entities.name: Venus
entities.body: The goddess of love and mother of Cupid.

entities.name: King Cophetua
entities.body: The legendary king who falls in love with a beggar maid.

entities.name: Cophetua’s beggar maid
entities.body: The poor young woman loved by King Cophetua in the ballad.

entities.name: Jove
entities.body: Jupiter, the Roman king of the gods.

entities.name: Echo
entities.body: The nymph whose voice repeats other people’s words.

entities.name: The sun god
entities.body: The divine charioteer of the sun, invoked as Titan and Phoebus.

entities.name: Phaeton
entities.body: The youth who tries to drive the sun’s chariot in Greek myth.

entities.name: Saint Francis
entities.body: Francis of Assisi, the saint associated with the friars’ order.

entities.name: Jesus
entities.body: The Christian figure invoked as Jesu or Jesus.

entities.name: Mary
entities.body: The mother of Jesus, invoked as Maria or Our Lady.

entities.name: Petrarch
entities.body: The Italian poet celebrated for his love poetry about Laura.

entities.name: Laura
entities.body: The woman addressed in Petrarch’s love poetry.

entities.name: Dido
entities.body: The queen of Carthage and lover of Aeneas in the Aeneid.

entities.name: Cleopatra
entities.body: The Egyptian queen, invoked among famous women celebrated in love stories.

entities.name: Helen
entities.body: The famed beauty associated with the Trojan War.

entities.name: Hero
entities.body: Leander’s beloved in the classical love story.

entities.name: Thisbe
entities.body: Pyramus’s beloved in the classical love story.

entities.name: God
entities.body: The deity invoked in prayers and exclamations throughout the play.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.body: Luck imagined as a power governing human lives.

entities.name: Death
entities.body: Death personified in the characters’ imagery, sometimes as a rival lover.
